title: The four Sessions pages each do header and back-navigation differently
what_happens: List: h1 'Sessions'. Detail: no h1, code in small caps, links to the other two as outlined buttons with '→'. Synthesis: '← code' link above an h1. Logs: small-caps 'CODE · LLM CALL LOGS', topic, then '← Back to session' below. Synthesis and Logs don't link to each other, and the top nav never shows where you are.
who_hurts: Dane moving between a session's summary, its logs and its settings has to go back to the detail page each time and re-orient on each screen.
suggested_fix: One shared session header (topic as h1, code + status line, and a small tab row: Overview · Synthesis · Logs with the current one marked) used by all three session pages; mark 'Sessions' active in the top nav.
rule: established pattern: Synthesis page header (back link + h1 + one-line purpose)
